meta.purpose: Стратегия и стандарты тестирования TripVibe. LLM MUST следовать при написании и генерации тестов.

layer.name: integration
layer.examples: POST /api/bookings, searchListings query, submitReview with rating update

rule.title: Colocated unit tests
rule.description: Unit tests рядом с source: parseSearchParams.test.ts рядом с parseSearchParams.ts. Component tests: ComponentName.test.tsx рядом с ComponentName.tsx.

rule.title: E2E in tests/e2e/
rule.description: Playwright specs: tests/e2e/search.spec.ts, booking.spec.ts, profile.spec.ts. Shared fixtures: tests/e2e/fixtures/.

rule.title: Integration tests in tests/integration/
rule.description: API route tests с test database: tests/integration/booking.api.test.ts. Use separate DATABASE_URL for test (e.g. tripvibe_test).

rule.title: AAA pattern
rule.description: Arrange → Act → Assert. One logical assertion group per test case.

rule.title: Descriptive test names
rule.description: Format: it('should {expected behavior} when {condition}'). Example: it('should return empty array when city not found').

rule.title: URL utils roundtrip tests
rule.description: MUST test: parseSearchParams(buildSearchUrl(params)) === params for all filter combinations. Edge cases: empty params, invalid dates, out-of-range guests.

rule.title: Price calculation tests
rule.description: calculateTotalPrice MUST have tests for: - single night, multi-night, - zero fees, with cleaning + service fees, - invalid dates (checkOut ≤ checkIn) → throw/return error.

rule.title: Rating aggregation tests
rule.description: calculateAverageRating: empty reviews → 0, single review, multiple reviews, rounding to 1 decimal.

rule.title: Testing Library queries
rule.description: Prefer getByRole, getByLabelText, getByText. Avoid getByTestId except for non-semantic elements (icons, dynamic lists).

rule.title: User event simulation
rule.description: Use @testing-library/user-event (not fireEvent) for clicks, typing, keyboard. FavoriteButton: click → optimistic heart fill → API mock → verify state.

rule.title: Mock external dependencies
rule.description: Mock: next/navigation (useRouter, useSearchParams), fetch/API calls, Mapbox. Do NOT mock the component under test.

rule.title: Accessibility assertions
rule.description: Interactive components: test keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Escape). StarRating: aria-label="Rate N stars".

rule.title: Test database isolation
rule.description: Each test suite: beforeAll seed minimal data, afterEach truncate mutable tables (or transaction rollback). NEVER run tests against development or production database.

rule.title: Auth mocking for protected endpoints
rule.description: Integration tests for protected routes MUST mock auth session with test userId. Test both authenticated and unauthenticated (expect 401).

rule.title: Booking overlap test
rule.description: MUST test: creating booking on occupied dates → 409 Conflict. Parallel booking attempt (simulate race) → only one succeeds.

rule.title: Review eligibility test
rule.description: Test matrix: - completed booking → 201, - pending booking → 403, - already reviewed → 409, - wrong user → 403.

rule.title: Critical path coverage
rule.description: MUST have E2E tests for: 1) Search flow: home → enter city → select dates → search → filter by price → click listing. 2) Booking flow: listing → select dates → checkout → see price breakdown → mock pay → profile shows trip. 3) Favorites: toggle heart → profile/favorites shows listing. 4) Review: completed trip → submit review → appears on listing page.

rule.title: URL state persistence
rule.description: E2E: apply filters → copy URL → new page load → filters restored. Browser back from listing → search filters preserved.

rule.title: Page Object pattern
rule.description: tests/e2e/pages/HomePage.ts, SearchPage.ts, ListingPage.ts, CheckoutPage.ts. Specs use page objects, not raw selectors inline.

rule.title: Stable selectors
rule.description: Prefer data-testid for E2E-critical elements: search-submit, filter-price-slider, book-button, favorite-toggle. Add data-testid in components for E2E targets (not for all elements).

rule.title: AI concierge smoke test
rule.description: Mock OpenAI response in E2E (route interception). Verify: widget opens, question submitted, response rendered. Do NOT call real OpenAI in CI.

module_tests.required: parseSearchParams, buildSearchUrl, SearchFilters component, search API integration
AvailabilityCalendar, ImageGallery keyboard nav, concierge API (mocked AI)
FavoriteButton optimistic update, trips list API, auth guard

rule.title: CI pipeline stages
rule.description: 1) lint (eslint), 2) typecheck (tsc --noEmit), 3) unit+integration (vitest), 4) E2E (playwright, on PR to main only). All stages MUST pass before merge.

rule.title: Coverage thresholds
rule.description: Vitest coverage thresholds (vitest.config.ts): shared/utils: 90%, modules/*/utils: 80%, overall: 70%. Coverage drop on PR → warning comment, not block (until Phase 3).

rule.title: No flaky tests
rule.description: E2E: use waitFor with explicit conditions, not fixed sleep. Retry failed E2E once in CI. Third failure → block merge.

rule.title: Mock payment in all test envs
rule.description: mock-pay MUST complete in <100ms in test mode (skip artificial delay). Detect via NODE_ENV=test or PAYMENT_MOCK_FAST=true.

rule.title: Seed data for E2E
rule.description: Dedicated E2E seed: known listing IDs, user credentials (test@tripvibe.dev / password). Document in tests/e2e/README.md.

rule.title: Mapbox mock
rule.description: Component tests: mock react-map-gl with div placeholder. E2E: map container visible, marker not required to render tiles.
